Civil Engineer Job at Aut Energy Resources Limited




        
    

        
        Aut Energy Resources Limited, am Oil and Gas servicing company, is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Civil Engineer

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: Oil & Gas
Level: Mid

Job Summary


	We seek a competent Civil Engineer to plan, supervise, and deliver civil and structural works for oil and gas servicing projects. The role requires sound technical judgment, field experience, and a strong commitment to quality and HSE standards.


Key Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Plan and supervise construction, renovation, and maintenance work.
	Review drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, and method statements.
	Monitor site activities, materials, schedules, costs, and workmanship.
	Conduct site inspections, surveys, measurements, and quality checks.
	Coordinate contractors, vendors, consultants, HSE, and project teams.
	Prepare progress reports, technical documentation, and project records.
	Ensure compliance with approved designs, regulations, and HSE requirements.
	Identify site risks and resolve technical issues promptly.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Civil Engineering.
	Minimum of five years’ relevant experience, preferably in oil and gas services.
	Knowledge of concrete, steel structures, foundations, drainage, and roadworks.
	Ability to interpret civil and structural drawings.
	Proficiency in AutoCAD and relevant engineering software.
	Familiarity with project planning, quality control, and industry standards.
	Professional registration or certification is an advantage.
	Strong communication, analytical, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
	Willingness to work at project sites when required.


Remuneration
N350,000 to N500,000 / month.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using " Civil Engineer Application" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Sourcing / Procurement Officer Job at Eizog Limited




        
    

        
        Eizog Limited deals in industrial spare parts, including electrical spare parts, instrumentation spare parts, and mechanical spare parts. The company supports customers that require dependable sourcing, accurate technical specifications, competitive pricing, and timely delivery of critical components.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:
Job Position: Sourcing / Procurement Officer
Job Location: Ojodu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Purpose
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The Sourcing / Procurement Officer will manage sourcing and purchasing activities from supplier identification through purchase order administration and preparation of supplier payment documentation.
	The roleholder will help the company secure the right spare parts at competitive prices, within required quality standards and delivery timelines, while maintaining reliable supplier relationships and procurement records.


Key Responsibilities


	Sourcing & Research: Identify and evaluate potential suppliers based on pricing, quality, delivery speed, and reliability.
	Contract Negotiation: Negotiate favorable commercial terms, pricing, payment schedules, and delivery timelines with vendors.
	Vendor Management: Build and maintain strong supplier relationships while monitoring ongoing performance.
	Purchase Order Administration: Create, track, and manage purchase orders (POs) to ensure accurate and timely fulfillment.
	Cost & Data Analysis: Analyze spending patterns, market trends, and invoices to identify cost-saving opportunities and resolve discrepancies.
	Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure purchasing activities follow company policies and local trade laws while mitigating supply chain risks.
	Preparing Fund Transfers: Ensure fund transfers are prepared to ensure payment to suppliers.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Education: HND in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
	Sourcing Experience: Experience in sourcing for Instrumentation / Electrical Spares, Automation, & Mechanical spare parts, preferably in the manufacturing industry.
	Experience: 2 - 4 years of professional experience in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain operations.
	Soft Skills: Strong communication, sharp negotiation abilities, and high attention to detail.
	Certifications: Credentials like Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) are a strong plus.


Key Competencies:


	Commercial judgment and cost awareness
	Negotiation and supplier relationship management
	Planning, follow-through, and attention to detail
	Data analysis and procurement reporting
	Problem solving and timely escalation
	Integrity, confidentiality, and compliance awareness
	Clear communication and cross-functional collaboration


Measures of Success:


	Shorter sourcing and purchase-order cycle times for approved requests
	Competitive pricing and documented cost savings or cost avoidance
	Improved supplier reliability, quality, and on-time delivery
	Accurate purchase orders, invoices, payment documentation, and procurement records
	Timely escalation and resolution of supply, pricing, quality, and compliance risks


Benefits


	Salary: N200,000 - N300,000 monthly.
	HMO coverage.
	13th month salary, in line with company policy.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Senior Project Manager",
  "description": "Seismic Consulting Group Limited is a multidisciplinary advisory and innovation firm committed to delivering data-driven, tech-enabled, and impact-focused solutions to global development challenges. With core competencies spanning consultancy, technology, vocational education, infrastructure, fintech, and artificial intelligence, Seismic operates at the intersection of innovation and development to serve governments, donor agencies, and the private sector.

Our flagship innovation hub, the Seismic AI Lab, pioneers applied research and digital tools that enhance decision-making and service delivery in sectors such as education, governance, health, and financial inclusion. As a mission-driven company, Seismic combines the operational rigor of international consulting firms with the agility of a tech startup, ensuring quality, compliance, and client satisfaction across all engagements.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Senior Project Manager

Job Location: Maitama, Abuja (FCT)

Employment Type: Full-time

About The Role


	As we continue to grow and take on new opportunities, we&rsquo;re looking for a Project Manager to join our team and be part of our next stage of growth.
	We&rsquo;re looking for someone who can lead with confidence, think beyond the day-to-day tasks, connect the bigger picture, and bring people together to turn plans into results.For us, it&rsquo;s not just about managing projects.
	It&rsquo;s about taking ownership, solving problems, collaborating across teams, and continuously looking for better ways to do things.
	The ideal candidate should also possess strong experience in project planning, financial oversight, risk management, monitoring and evaluation, technical reporting, stakeholder engagement and donor compliance, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within demanding project environments.
	The Project Manager owns the on-time, on-budget and on-quality delivery of one or more donor-funded projects, leading multi-disciplinary teams of consultants and technical experts, to ensure every deliverable meets acceptable standards and contract terms.
	The ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong understanding of donor-funded project management frameworks, including theirimplementation methodologies, reporting standards,programme delivery, compliance requirements, procurement and reporting procedures.
	Previous hands-on experience managing projects funded by GIZ, the British Council, the World Bank or comparable international development partners will be a key consideration in the selection process.


Key Roles and Responsibilities
Project delivery and planning:


	Lead end-to-end delivery of assigned projects against the terms of reference, contract, work plan and budget.
	Develop detailed work plans, schedules, resource plans and risk registers, and update them as conditions change.
	Track milestones, deliverables and expenditure; flag risks, delays and scope changes early and propose solutions.
	Run project start-up, including inception reports, kick-off meetings and mobilisation of teams.


Client and stakeholder management:


	Serve as the main day-to-day contact for task teams, development agencies, government counterparts and other stakeholders.
	Prepare and present progress reports, briefings and deliverables that meet donor quality and formatting standards.
	Coordinate with beneficiaries, implementing partners and local authorities, including during field missions.


Team and technical leadership:


	Lead and motivate multi-disciplinary teams of staff, sector specialists and short-term consultants across several sectors.
	Assign tasks, set quality standards and review technical outputs before submission to the client.
	Coordinate subcontractors and joint-venture partners, and manage their performance and deliverables.


Financial and contract management:


	Manage project budgets, forecasts, invoicing and cost control in line with contract terms and donor frameworks.
	Ensure compliance with World Bank procurement, fiduciary, safeguards and reporting requirements.
	Manage contract variations, amendments and close-out documentation.


Quality, monitoring and learning:


	Apply monitoring and evaluation frameworks to track results and report on outcomes, not only outputs.
	Maintain quality assurance processes and document lessons learned for use across Seismic projects.


Business development support:


	Contribute to expressions of interest, technical and financial proposals, and bid strategy for new development-sector opportunities.
	Support client relationship growth and help build Seismic&#39;s reputation for delivery.


Qualifications and Experience
Required:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Project Management, Development Studies, Public Policy, Economics,&nbsp;Engineering, Social Sciences or a related field; a master&#39;s Degree is an advantage.
	5&ndash;10 years of project management experience, including at least [4] years leading donor-funded projects.
	Demonstrated experience delivering projects for the World Bank, or comparable agencies such as the AfDB, UN agencies, FCDO, USAID or the EU.

Senior Project Manager Job at Seismic Consulting Group Limited




        
    

        
        Seismic Consulting Group Limited is a multidisciplinary advisory and innovation firm committed to delivering data-driven, tech-enabled, and impact-focused solutions to global development challenges. With core competencies spanning consultancy, technology, vocational education, infrastructure, fintech, and artificial intelligence, Seismic operates at the intersection of innovation and development to serve governments, donor agencies, and the private sector.

Our flagship innovation hub, the Seismic AI Lab, pioneers applied research and digital tools that enhance decision-making and service delivery in sectors such as education, governance, health, and financial inclusion. As a mission-driven company, Seismic combines the operational rigor of international consulting firms with the agility of a tech startup, ensuring quality, compliance, and client satisfaction across all engagements.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Project Manager

Job Location: Maitama, Abuja (FCT)

Employment Type: Full-time

About The Role


	As we continue to grow and take on new opportunities, we’re looking for a Project Manager to join our team and be part of our next stage of growth.
	We’re looking for someone who can lead with confidence, think beyond the day-to-day tasks, connect the bigger picture, and bring people together to turn plans into results.For us, it’s not just about managing projects.
	It’s about taking ownership, solving problems, collaborating across teams, and continuously looking for better ways to do things.
	The ideal candidate should also possess strong experience in project planning, financial oversight, risk management, monitoring and evaluation, technical reporting, stakeholder engagement and donor compliance, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within demanding project environments.
	The Project Manager owns the on-time, on-budget and on-quality delivery of one or more donor-funded projects, leading multi-disciplinary teams of consultants and technical experts, to ensure every deliverable meets acceptable standards and contract terms.
	The ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong understanding of donor-funded project management frameworks, including theirimplementation methodologies, reporting standards,programme delivery, compliance requirements, procurement and reporting procedures.
	Previous hands-on experience managing projects funded by GIZ, the British Council, the World Bank or comparable international development partners will be a key consideration in the selection process.


Key Roles and Responsibilities
Project delivery and planning:


	Lead end-to-end delivery of assigned projects against the terms of reference, contract, work plan and budget.
	Develop detailed work plans, schedules, resource plans and risk registers, and update them as conditions change.
	Track milestones, deliverables and expenditure; flag risks, delays and scope changes early and propose solutions.
	Run project start-up, including inception reports, kick-off meetings and mobilisation of teams.


Client and stakeholder management:


	Serve as the main day-to-day contact for task teams, development agencies, government counterparts and other stakeholders.
	Prepare and present progress reports, briefings and deliverables that meet donor quality and formatting standards.
	Coordinate with beneficiaries, implementing partners and local authorities, including during field missions.


Team and technical leadership:


	Lead and motivate multi-disciplinary teams of staff, sector specialists and short-term consultants across several sectors.
	Assign tasks, set quality standards and review technical outputs before submission to the client.
	Coordinate subcontractors and joint-venture partners, and manage their performance and deliverables.


Financial and contract management:


	Manage project budgets, forecasts, invoicing and cost control in line with contract terms and donor frameworks.
	Ensure compliance with World Bank procurement, fiduciary, safeguards and reporting requirements.
	Manage contract variations, amendments and close-out documentation.


Quality, monitoring and learning:


	Apply monitoring and evaluation frameworks to track results and report on outcomes, not only outputs.
	Maintain quality assurance processes and document lessons learned for use across Seismic projects.


Business development support:


	Contribute to expressions of interest, technical and financial proposals, and bid strategy for new development-sector opportunities.
	Support client relationship growth and help build Seismic's reputation for delivery.


Qualifications and Experience
Required:


	Bachelor's Degree in Project Management, Development Studies, Public Policy, Economics, Engineering, Social Sciences or a related field; a master's Degree is an advantage.
	5–10 years of project management experience, including at least [4] years leading donor-funded projects.
	Demonstrated experience delivering projects for the World Bank, or comparable agencies such as the AfDB, UN agencies, FCDO, USAID or the EU.
	Strong knowledge of World Bank procedures, including procurement, safeguards, fiduciary and reporting requirements.
	Proven record of managing budgets, schedules, risks and multi-disciplinary teams across more than one sector.
	Excellent written and spoken English, with strong report-writing and presentation skills.
	Advanced skills in MS Office and project management tools (MS Project, Asana, Trello or similar).


Preferred:


	PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification.
	Experience with monitoring and evaluation, data collection, or digital delivery platforms.
	Experience writing or contributing to proposals and expressions of interest for development tenders.
	Familiarity with the public sector and development context in Nigeria and across Africa.
	Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for field missions and client meetings.


Core Competencies:


	Delivery focus: keeps complex, multi-sector work on schedule and within budget.
	Stakeholder skills: builds trust with donors, governments and partners and handles difficult conversations with tact.
	Leadership: guides diverse teams, delegates well and holds a high standard for quality.
	Analytical judgement: weighs evidence and risk, and makes sound decisions under pressure.
	Adaptability: works comfortably across sectors, geographies and changing donor priorities.
	Integrity: applies donor compliance, ethics and confidentiality standards without exception.
